culture.text: A sports brand covering running, golf, volleyball and more, with a mission framed around transforming lives through sport.
Japanese sports equipment and sportswear company based in Osaka, founded in 1906, with about 5,808 employees.
Its Dutch operation is in Capelle aan den IJssel, near Rotterdam.

open.text: Mizuno Corporation Netherlands is an IND recognised sponsor.
Its one open role here, a senior finance job, does not require Dutch.

worth_knowing.text: Launched the Hyperwarp 96, a 96-gram racing shoe lighter than Adidas' top marathon racer.
